versioning: patch release: MPI containment (per-job rendezvous directory, launcher identity filter, escape reporting); no new scheduling input, no schema change
node_config: config/zenobia-node.json: the live 0.7.1 node.json plus the containment section (defaults: enabled, tmp_base /tmp, scan_seconds 60)
features: per-job temporary and MPI rendezvous directory /tmp/simq.<job>.<token12> (mode 700; made by the job wrapper, removed at the job's end, by the worker if the wrapper was killed): TMPDIR, PMIX_SYSTEM_TMPDIR, PMIX_SERVER_TMPDIR, PRTE_MCA_prte_tmpdir_base and SIMQ_TMPDIR; prun / prterun --dvm search can no longer attach to a PRRTE DVM outside the job (they fail instead); -e wins
inherited MPI launcher identity variables (PMIX_* but PMIX_MCA_*, PRTE_* but PRTE_MCA_*, PMI_*, OMPI_COMM_WORLD_*, ...) dropped from job environments unless given with -e

escape scan (reads /proc, report only): processes carrying a job's SIMQ_LAUNCH_TOKEN outside its cgroup -> escaped.json, escaped-process event, worker log, simq show; MPI launcher daemons outside every job -> containment.json, simq partitions, simq doctor; every containment.scan_seconds while jobs run and at each job's end
two-rank reproduction on the live 0.7.1 queue (job 1175): prun ranks ran in an outside DVM's scope, mpiexec ranks in the job unit; test_containment.py reproduces and checks the fix
